task: View return or cancel an order
synonyms: cancel an Amazon order, return an item, start an order cancellation, view your returns

trail.instruction: Click the product you want to return or cancel from your orders list.
trail.label: Hobestluk Big Bean Bag Chairs for Adults Fireside BeanBag Couch Togo Sofa

trail.instruction: Click the "Returns" link on the product page to open the return/cancel options.
trail.label: Returns

trail.instruction: You should now be on the Your Returns page where you can choose to cancel or return the item.
